# UK IPTV BOX

> A UK IPTV subscription service offering 50,000+ live channels and 60,000+ films
> and series in up to 4K, from £14.99 for one month to £49.99 for twelve. Works on
> Fire Stick, smart TV, Apple TV, Android, iPhone, MAG and Formuler hardware.
> Support is handled over WhatsApp by a UK-hours team.

Pricing is flat: no per-room charge, no picture-quality upgrade, no setup fee and
no auto-renewal. Plans are 1 month (£14.99), 3 months (£26.99), 6 months (£36.99)
and 12 months (£49.99, the best value at £4.17/month).

## Buying guides

- [IPTV vs Sky TV UK 2026](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/iptv-vs-sky-tv-uk/): full cost comparison; a Sky sports household pays £860 to £1,320 a year against £49.99, and the three things Sky still does better.
- [IPTV Subscription UK Buyer's Guide](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/iptv-subscription-uk-buyers-guide/): server uptime, EPG quality, catch-up, trial length and payment safety.
- [Best IPTV Provider UK](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/best-iptv-provider-uk/): scorecard of uptime, support speed, refund windows and connection limits.
- [Cheap IPTV UK: Scam or Legit?](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/cheap-iptv-uk-scam-or-legit/): eight red flags of a scam listing and why legitimate UK IPTV has a price floor of roughly £8 to £10 a month.
- [IPTV Free Trial UK](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/iptv-free-trial-uk/): what to test before paying, and why a paid 30-day test beats a free 24-hour link.
- [Top 5 IPTV Boxes UK 2026](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/top-5-iptv-boxes-uk-2026/): Formuler Z11 Pro Max, Fire Stick 4K Max, Nvidia Shield, BuzzTV and MAG ranked.
- [Best IPTV Player Apps UK 2026](https://ukiptvbox.com/blog/best-iptv-player-apps-2026-uk/): Smarters Pro, TiviMate and OTT Navigator compared.
